title: Mobile App Developer Intern
description:
**Duration:** 3 Months

**Type:** Full\-time Internship

**Location:** Coimbatore

**Job Description**

We are looking for a Mobile App Developer Intern to help develop Android and iOS applications.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain mobile application features for Android and iOS using React Native.
* Build reusable, responsive and user\-friendly UI components based on design requirements.
* Integrate REST APIs and handle loading states, responses and basic errors correctly.
* Manage application data and global state efficiently using Redux Toolkit.
* Implement screen navigation and data passing between screens using React Navigation.
* Identify, debug and fix basic UI, functionality and performance issues.
* Use Git and GitHub for version control, branch management and team collaboration.
* Follow coding standards and work with developers and designers to complete assigned tasks.

**Required Skills** 

* Basic knowledge of React Native and cross\-platform mobile application development.
* Good understanding of JavaScript, TypeScript and modern ES6 concepts.
* Familiarity with React components, props, state and commonly used hooks.
* Basic knowledge of Redux Toolkit for application state management.
* Experience integrating REST APIs using Fetch or Axios.
* Familiarity with React Navigation and reusable, responsive UI development.
* Basic knowledge of Git, GitHub, branches, commits and pull requests.
* Understanding of debugging and clean coding; Flutter and Dart knowledge is optional.

**Eligibility**

Fresher with basic React Native knowledge. Knowledge of Flutter, personal projects, or a GitHub profile will be an added advantage.

Work Location: In person

title: Flutter Developer
description:
**Position Overview**

We are looking for a skilled **Flutter Developer with 2\+ years of experience** to develop responsive, scalable, and high\-performance mobile applications for **Android and iOS**. The candidate will work closely with product, UI/UX, and cross\-functional teams throughout the development lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, test, and maintain mobile applications using **Flutter and Dart**.
* Build responsive and visually appealing **Flutter UI/UX**.
* Implement state management using **Provider, Riverpod, BLoC**, or similar frameworks.
* Integrate **REST APIs, JSON services, and third\-party APIs**.
* Implement **Firebase services**, including authentication, notifications, and analytics.
* Work with **SQLite/local storage** and support offline functionality.
* Develop and maintain applications for **Android and iOS**.
* Work with **Kotlin** for Android\-specific features, integrations, and native functionality.
* Optimize applications for **performance, scalability, and reliability**.
* Follow **Clean Architecture** and develop reusable, maintainable components.
* Debug, test, and troubleshoot applications across devices and platforms.
* Use **Git/GitHub** for version control and participate in code reviews.
* Deploy and maintain applications on the **Google Play Store and Apple App Store**.
* Collaborate with teams to understand requirements and deliver solutions within timelines.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in **Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or a related field**.
* **2\+ years of professional experience in Flutter development**.
* Strong proficiency in **Dart and Flutter**.
* Good knowledge of **Kotlin and Android development**.
* Hands\-on experience with **responsive UI/UX development**.
* Good knowledge of **state management, REST APIs, JSON, Firebase, and SQLite/local storage**.
* Experience with **Git/GitHub, push notifications, and third\-party API integration**.
* Understanding of **Clean Architecture, testing, debugging, and performance optimization**.
* Good understanding of **Android and iOS development using Flutter**.
* Experience with **Agile/Scrum** practices.
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with **native Android/iOS development**.
* Knowledge of **Kotlin Android development** and native Flutter integrations.
* Experience with **CI/CD and mobile app release processes**.
* Experience working across **Development, QA, and Production environments**.
* Familiarity with **crash reporting and application performance monitoring tools**.
* Experience building applications with **complex UI, API integrations, and offline capabilities**.

Pay: ₹27,000\.00 \- ₹32,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
